explanation: The theorem says the library's own `extensionMap` (L ⊗[k] R → K ⊗[k] R, defined as `Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom L L K) (AlgHom.id k R)`) factors through M. The only close Mathlib lemma is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp`. It needs both factors to be algebra maps over the same base S, so it doesn't apply here. The first map is an L-algebra map and the second is an M-algebra map, and the codomain bases differ (L-linear versus M-linear). So `map_comp` can't be applied without extra work. I also searched the TensorProduct files for `map_map`, `comp_map` and `map_trans` variants and found nothing matching. The content is the library's own definition plus `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply`, so I found no Mathlib duplicate.
